svg.title: Terraform Lab 03 — Routing, firewall policy and Cloud NAT
svg.desc: Firewall rules decide who may connect in; Cloud Router + Cloud NAT give private VMs outbound-only internet access
svg.text: Terraform Lab 03 — Routing, firewall policy and Cloud NAT
Firewall rules decide who may connect in; Cloud Router + Cloud NAT give private VMs outbound-only internet access
✓ IAP range → tcp:22 on tag iap-ssh
✗ everything else ingress is denied (implied rule)
to a Google-managed public IP + port
Reply returns to the NAT mapping
stateful: allowed back to the VM
no mapping → dropped; VM stays unreachable
Firewall rules are per VPC but attach by network tag; the implied rules are deny-all ingress and allow-all egress.
Cloud NAT is not a VM: it is a managed, outbound-only translation service attached to a Cloud Router.
